semantics.task_success: Only independent evaluator score.success; training proxy and exit=0 never imply task success. Per-contract or first-grasp success kept separate.
semantics.null: Not explicitly available or not evaluated; no false default.
semantics.run_identity: Closed-loop top-level directory; nested summary/video metadata/checkpoint table/state references are not extra rollouts. A blocked directory remains distinct even if manifest reuses a run_name.
semantics.validation_scope: Standalone validation evaluator rollouts are separately labelled diagnostic/assisted; task success there is not autonomous long-task capability.
semantics.training_steps: Actual observed counter, not planned max; continued segments are not additive.
semantics.source_archive: source_records.json.gz preserves exact UTF-8 bytes via sha256-keyed text blobs; repeated identical content deduplicated, paths remain complete.
semantics.code_snapshot: Current source text snapshots cannot establish old runtime identity; old manifest hashes identify historical versions.
semantics.log_coverage: Only bounded prefix exception match and final 4KiB tail; no raw sensor/action JSONL scanned. Absence in a partial search is unknown.
